## Rules / Compliance Checklist

Please confirm your PR follows the project conventions:

- [ ] Naming conventions follow **PascalCase** where required
- [ ] No unintended new files were added
- [ ] File structure matches the existing Koboi architecture
- [ ] No dead or unused code introduced
- [ ] Code is readable and properly formatted
- [ ] No debug prints / temporary logs left in production code
- [ ] Comments are meaningful (not redundant or obvious)
- [ ] Changes are scoped and do not mix unrelated concerns
- [ ] Functions/modules remain focused and modular
- [ ] No breaking changes without justification
- [ ] Public APIs (if any) are documented or updated accordingly
